Unlocking the Power of Procurement Analytics for Supply Chain Digitization Procurement
analytics provide powerful insights for understanding and optimizing spending patterns, an
essential step in supply chain digitization.

By analyzing purchase order (PO) data, supply
chain managers can identify inefficiencies, reduce costs, and make data-driven decisions
to improve procurement performance.

This guide walks through a Python-based solution for
procurement analytics, complete with code, insights, and visualizations.

Step 1: Data
Loading and Preprocessing We start by loading PO data into a clean format using Python and
the pandas library.
This ensures accuracy for subsequent analysis.

Step 2: Supplier Spend
Analysis Analyzing spend by supplier helps identify key partners and potential cost-saving
opportunities.
